visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair tied in a half-up style sits at a mahjong table, wearing a denim button-down shirt. She smiles and talks animatedly, her eyes bright and her hands gesturing. The mahjong table has a brown textured surface with numerous tiles scattered across it in a brightly lit indoor studio. (2) Close-up shots follow, focusing on the woman's hands as she uses her thumb to feel the engraved patterns on the faces of various mahjong tiles. She is wearing a thin gold necklace and a ring. Subtitles in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom, and a 'Mahjong Beginner' tag is visible. (3) A blonde woman wearing a black t-shirt with a 'SML' logo joins the table, sitting to the right. She focuses intently on the mahjong tiles, her hands also reaching out to touch and feel them. The background is a simple white wall, maintaining a clean studio aesthetic. (4) A man with glasses and a black baseball cap featuring the same 'SML' logo holds a mahjong tile up to the camera. He points at the '7-Wan' character, demonstrating how to identify the specific 'cross' shape by touch. He wears a white t-shirt and a dark watch. (5) The blonde woman practices the identification, her facial expressions showing intense concentration followed by a broad smile as she correctly guesses the tiles. The camera cuts rapidly between her face and the tiles to match the energetic pace of the conversation. (6) The participants are shown laughing and talking together in a medium shot. The woman in the denim shirt applauds, and the scene ends with the blonde woman giving a thumbs-up gesture, signaling a successful practice session in the consistent studio environment.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 搓牌初心者. [Subtitle]: 你覺得最難搓的是哪一張？ (2) [Subtitle]: 六七九萬. 你應該讓我先搓. (3) [Subtitle]: 七萬. 喔. 六萬. 喔. 第一摸摸到這個勾勾就摸得出是七萬. (4) [Variety]: 完全不會搓牌. [Subtitle]: 指甲有影響你搓牌嗎？ (5) [Subtitle]: 我知道問題在哪裡了. 重點就是那個施力點沒有找到. 你就是一隻手拿牌嘛對不對. (6) [Subtitle]: 七萬的話就是這個十字架. 搓起來它就是一個十. 九萬呢它很像這樣兩條線. 六萬它也是兩條線可是它斜斜的. (7) [Subtitle]: 六九條也是摸起來軟軟的. 九條就是尖尖刺刺的. (8) [Subtitle]: 這個是六萬吧？NO. 欸九萬. 六萬. (9) [Subtitle]: 謝謝81老師. 我也要喔. 七餅. 六. 六餅. (10) [Subtitle]: 學會了嗎肉肉同學.
